BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2025)
CLASS:  BBA   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: MANAGEMENT   SESSION: SP/2025

SUBJECT: MT316 INTERNATIONAL MARKETING

TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1 What is  international marketing? Describe various opportunities  and challenges in
international marketing created by new development in geopolitical scenario.
[5] 1 3


Q.2 Discuss  the  various  types  of  international  marketing.  Explain  the  most  pertinent
reasons due to which companies choose to enter in international marketing.
[5] 1 2,3


Q.3 Discuss  the  impact  of  environmental  factors  on  overall  international  marketing
planning process.
[5] 2 4


Q.4 Explain the concept of balance of payment (BOP). Discuss its components.  [5] 2 2


Q.5 What are trade barriers? Discuss the rationale behind government’s intervention on
international trade with suitable examples.
[5] 3
